identification: Pro Hart, hand coloured line etching from the Littlewode Press 'Waltzing Matilda' series (Series 1), swagman floating in the billabong ('His Ghost May Be Heard'), 12.7 x 14.7 cm plate, framed. The plate bears 'Pro Hart' in the plate (not a pencil signature).
